verification: Read official primary current-master source via web. This documents current toolkit behavior, not a pinned historical generator for the locally downloaded YCB-V masks.
current_bop19_rule: For rendered-model distance d_model>0, visible if d_model-d_test<=delta OR scene d_test==0. Missing scene depth is therefore admitted as visible in this mode; missing depth alone does not support an explanation that the pixel became covered.
current_bop18_rule: Requires positive scene and rendered-model distance; missing scene depth is not visible.
current_mask_script: Renders the GT model in its supplied pose; full silhouette is positive rendered distance. It calls visibility with bop19 and defaults delta to15mm (script notes5mm for ITODD). Scene and rendered Z-depth are converted to distance images before comparison.
local_historical_generation_mode: NOT_CERTIFIED_BY_THIS_REVIEW. Existing pinned archive/PNG hashes certify received bytes; they do not establish generator commit, renderer, alignment, actual visibility delta, or bop18/19 mode used to produce those bytes.
implications: Do not attribute source C errors to missing-depth holes without establishing generation mode and per-pixel evidence.

Native M4 is target-owned visible-mask PROXY, not perfect human RGB semantic gold. Render/mesh/pose alignment, edge rasterization, depth noise/tolerance, missing-depth treatment and true occlusion remain distinct possible sources of discrepancy.
M0 minus M4 stays nonvisible expected-support proxy; it does not identify semantic external E, self S, or a specific occluder cause.
No mask repair, new GT, human-label training, delta/radius/threshold retuning or new fit is authorized by this addendum.
